description:
Option (b) deferred from JMAP-h47t.14. The current shape on TasksBackend exposes `fn enforce_is_draft_atomically(&self) -> bool` as a backend opt-in for atomic isDraft enforcement; when false, the handler does a get_objects pre-fetch. Workspace AGENTS.md 'Permission enforcement: backend canonical' rule says the backend is the canonical enforcement point regardless — the handler-side pre-fetch is defense-in-depth only. The cleaner shape is to remove the flag entirely, make atomic backend enforcement mandatory (per draft-tasks-06 §4 isDraft paragraph), and drop the handler short-circuit in task.rs:206-234.

Why deferred: the rec on JMAP-h47t.14 favored option (a) docs-only for the immediate fix and explicitly deferred option (b) to a separate workspace-coordinated trait sweep. The reason for the sweep framing: removing the flag changes the handler structure in jmap-tasks-server and would set a precedent the workspace's other extension-server siblings (mail, calendars, chat, etc.) should follow consistently if they grow analogous invariants. Mail-server has no isDraft analog today but the principle generalises.

Scope of the sweep:
1. Remove `TasksBackend::enforce_is_draft_atomically` trait method.
2. Remove the `!backend.enforce_is_draft_atomically()` short-circuit and pre-fetch path in task.rs:206-234.
3. Update MemoryBackend in memory.rs to drop the override (it already enforces atomically per the JMAP-h47t.4 fix).
4. Update MockBackend in lib.rs:tests if it overrides.
5. Verify task.rs tests still pass — set_is_draft_revert_rejected_when_current_is_false now exercises the backend path exclusively.
6. Per the canonical-template propagation rule, audit other extension-server siblings for analog 'backend enforces atomically' opt-in flags and remove them if found. Document the workspace-canonical principle in AGENTS.md so new flags are not added by future contributors.

This is an API-shape change (removes a trait method); pre-publish so cost is zero today.

Tracks the deferral made in JMAP-h47t.14 comment dated 2026-05-14 19:00.
title: Workspace sweep: remove enforce_is_draft_atomically flag, make backend-canonical isDraft enforcement mandatory
